messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and 429 spike detected for /v1/generate across prod regions (us-west-2, eu-west-1). 5xx rate up 6x, 429s up 12x; affected p95 latency +400ms. Pager triggered for SRE oncall. links: https://metrics.redwood.example/alerts/1799887654 :rotating_light:

maria (oncall): I’m on it. Appointing handoff to SRE. Paging jess. Any recent deploys or rate-limit changes?

jess (sre): I didn’t see a deploy in the last 30m. But there was a quota-policy change pushed 12:10 UTC by eng-platform (dave) that tightened tenant-level token buckets. Could be related. Pulling logs now.

kevin (eng-runtime): Confirmed increased 429s coming from quota-enforcer service. Logs show quota-eval latency spiking and upstream gateway timeouts. Snippet from quota-enforcer logs:```ERROR quota-eval id=tenant=acme corp latency=243ms allowed=0 reason=hard_limit```

maria (oncall): Good call. jess, can you triage quota-enforcer health? If it’s timing out, we should consider bypassing it for critical routes.

jess (sre): Working on it. Running `kubectl -n infra logs -l app=quota-enforcer --since=10m` now. Seeing repeated `grpc deadline exceeded` to redis-cluster-1. There’s a spike in redis read latencies. Could be hot keys from a sudden prefix cache miss.

dave (eng-platform): That quota change at 12:10 was a roll-forward of tenant enforcement to be stricter for large-tenants. We did a canary on small subset (should be safe) but looks like it accidentally included a tag that matched more tenants than intended. Rolling back now. Patch:```yaml
- name: tenant-quota-policy
  match: tags: ["high-commit","large-tenant"]
+ name: tenant-quota-policy
  match: tags: ["high-commit"]
```

sam (support): We already have customers starting to DM support about 502/429. Which tenants are impacted most? Need list to prepare comms.

jess (sre): I can dump top offenders: `SELECT tenant, count(*) FROM request_logs WHERE code IN (429,5xx) GROUP BY tenant ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10;` Top 3: acme-corp, beta-inc, playground-tenant. Will attach list.

maria (oncall): Immediate mitigations: (1) roll back quota-policy change (dave) — in progress, (2) temporary global softening of bucket thresholds for gateway route `/v1/generate`, (3) enable fallback routing to model-legacy for timed-out requests, (4) scale up quota-enforcer replicas and add redis read replicas. jess, please run step 2/3 asap.

jess (sre): Executed route softening: `redwoodctl rate override --route /v1/generate --factor 3 --scope global` — propagated. Also enabled fallback: `feature-flag set fallback:model-legacy true --route /v1/generate` so timed-out requests fall back. Scaling quota-enforcer to +3 replicas now.

kevin (eng-runtime): Noted. Adding a short lived bypass in the routing policy to skip quota-enforcer for requests tagged `internal` and `cs-critical` to keep pages down while rollback finishes. `route-config apply` in progress.

incident-bot: NOTE: mitigation actions applied: quota-policy rollback started, global route softening applied, fallback to model-legacy enabled, quota-enforcer scaled. Monitoring for 5xx/429 trend.

maria (oncall): Monitoring: after mitigations, 429s down ~78% over 5m window, 5xx down ~65%, p95 latency down ~230ms. Still watching. Sam, please start drafting CS note for affected tenants (acme-corp, beta-inc, playground-tenant) — mark as high priority.

sam (support): Drafting now. Will include: what happened, that a config change increased enforcement surface, mitigation steps taken (rollback + temporary softening + fallback), and ETA for full resolution.

dave (eng-platform): Rollback completed and verified. Root cause: incorrect tag selector in canary config that expanded enforcement to non-canary tenants. I’ve opened PR to add stronger selector validation and a canary isolation test: https://repo.redwood.example/PR/4567

jess (sre): Redis spikes were likely exacerbated by many requests hitting quota-enforcer after it started returning denies; added a small LRU cache in front of quota-enforcer to cut downstream reads. Will push hotfix PR after this.

maria (oncall): Nice. Next steps: (A) engage infra for redis perf post-mortem, (B) eng-platform to add stricter deploy guard + canary safety, (C) eng-runtime to review fallback behaviour and ensure no data leaks, (D) support to send comms. Assign owners: dave A/B, jess C, sam D.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. Assigned severity: Sev2. Incident channel: #incidents. Followup doc: docs-incident-1799887654 (create after lunch).

maria (oncall): Closing pager for now — we’ll stay on watch for 2 hours and then rotate off if stable. Thanks all :thumbsup:

sam (support): Sent customer comms to the top 3 tenants + public status update. Will post link to message here.

dave (eng-platform): Put follow-up checklist in PR and scheduled a post-mortem with stakeholders tomorrow 09:30 UTC.

maria (oncall): Great. Add retro items: validate tag selectors, improve canary isolation, add explicit dry-run alerts for quota-policy changes.

jess (sre): Saving logs and snapshots: `/mnt/archives/incidents/1799887654/` — will upload graphs and query results to the followup doc.

maria (oncall): Thanks team. If anything regresses ping this thread and we’ll reopen the pager.
